Timed out retrying after 40000ms: The command was expected to run against origin `https://staging.feenix.ai` but the application is at origin `https://trial-7739329.okta.com`.

This commonly happens when you have either not navigated to the expected origin or have navigated away unexpectedly.

Using `cy.origin()` to wrap the commands run on `https://trial-7739329.okta.com` will likely fix this issue.

`cy.origin('https://trial-7739329.okta.com', () => {`
`  <commands targeting https://trial-7739329.okta.com go here>`
`})`

https://on.cypress.io/cy-visit-succeeded-but-commands-fail
